name: DLC: Rauh, Abyssal Woods & Jagged Peak

legs.summary: Enter the Ancient Ruins of Rauh via the Moorth Ruins tunnel from Scadu Altus, descending into the wetland canyon of the Scorpion River (Rauh Base). The ruins are flooded, overgrown, and split by a chasm. Rauh Base connects to Shadow Keep via a great bridge to the east. Work the Taylew's Ruined Forge dungeon and Scorpion River Catacombs before ascending.

steps.text: From Moorth Ruins (Scadu Altus), take the hidden cave tunnel northeast to reach the Ancient Ruins Base grace. Head southeast along the canyon to the Temple Town Ruins. The Rauh Ruins map fragment is at the foot of a monolith near Temple Town Ruins. Rauh Base lies below the main ruins with its own graces.

legs.summary: Ascend through the Ancient Ruins of Rauh proper — the flooded upper ruins with scarlet rot swamp areas, Furnace Golems, and Divine Bird Warriors. Key items are scattered across the flooded platforms and hidden alcoves. Romina, Saint of the Bud is a MANDATORY boss — must be defeated to burn the Sealing Tree and reach Enir-Ilim. She resides at the Church of the Bud, which was burned during the Crusade. Dryleaf Dane can be summoned. Source: eldenring.wiki.gg/wiki/Ancient_Ruins_of_Rauh + Romina.

steps.text: From the Ancient Ruins Base, ascend the ruins via the viaduct. The Rauh Ancient Ruins East and West graces are mid-level. The Grand Stairway leads up to the Church of the Bud. The upper level has a scarlet rot swamp — use immunity items.

steps.text: Romina, Saint of the Bud — MANDATORY legend boss at the Church of the Bud, Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Must be defeated to burn the Sealing Tree and access Enir-Ilim. Dryleaf Dane co-op summon available. Source: eldenring.wiki.gg/wiki/Romina%2C_Saint_of_the_Bud.

legs.summary: Enter the Abyssal Woods via Darklight Catacombs at the terminus of Recluses' River in Scadu Altus. Jori, Elder Inquisitor guards the catacombs entrance. The woods are a thick forbidden forest at the ravine's depths, untouched by sunlight. CRITICAL: Torrent cannot be summoned here from fear. The woods contain beings that cannot be touched — stealth is required (crouch in undergrowth, avoid being seen). Navigate to Midra's Manse at the heart of the woods. Source: eldenring.wiki.gg/wiki/Abyssal_Woods.

steps.text: From Recluses' River (Scadu Altus), take the Darklight Catacombs path. Jori, Elder Inquisitor is the catacombs boss — defeat him to open the Abyssal Woods exit. In the woods: DO NOT be seen by the Finger Creeper-like invisible stalkers — they kill instantly and cannot be fought. Crouch through undergrowth and use the blind spots between their patrol paths. Torrent is unavailable. Follow the path to Midra's Manse in the southern woods.

steps.note: Dropped by Jori, Elder Inquisitor in the Darklight Catacombs. Source: items.json acquisition text.

steps.text: Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame — legend boss deep in Midra's Manse, the decaying manor in the southern Abyssal Woods. Navigate four floors of the manse (Manse Hall → upper floors → Midra's Library). Source: eldenring.wiki.gg/wiki/Midra%27s_Manse.

steps.note: Dropped by Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame. Trade at Roundtable Hold for Greatsword of Damnation or Midra's Flame of Frenzy. Source: items.json acquisition text.

From Midra's Library grace, move the bookshelf by pulling a lever in the same room — the balcony is directly above the inquisitor below. Torch on a corpse in a chair wearing yellow cloth. Source: items.json acquisition text.

legs.summary: Dragon's Pit is a cave dungeon reached from Gravesite Plain near Pillar Path Waypoint — bear south-southwest. Its dragon-themed architecture was a rite of passage for Dragon Communion practitioners. Defeat the Ancient Dragon-Man to reach Jagged Peak beyond. Ascend Jagged Peak's storm-battered peaks to face Bayle the Dread at the summit. Igon's summon sign is available at the fog gate — summoning Igon is OPTIONAL for Bayle but required for Igon's quest conclusion (his bell bearing and set only drop if you summon him). Source: eldenring.wiki.gg/wiki/Dragon%27s_Pit + Jagged_Peak + Igon.

steps.text: From Pillar Path Waypoint (Gravesite Plain), head south-southwest to Dragon's Pit cave entrance. A Magma Wyrm guards an upper chamber — optional but notable. The main boss is deeper in.

After defeating the Jagged Peak Drake on the mountainside, Igon screams in the road. Exhaust his dialogue until he gives you his Furled Finger and requests you face Bayle the Dread. Source: eldenring.wiki.gg/wiki/Igon.

steps.note: Given by Igon after defeating the Jagged Peak Drake, when you exhaust his dialogue. Source: items.json acquisition text.

steps.text: Ancient Dragon-Man — boss in Dragon's Pit Terminus. Awaits one worthy to face the Dread Dragon. Source: eldenring.wiki.gg/wiki/Dragon%27s_Pit.

steps.note: Found in Dragon's Pit. Source: items.json acquisition text (exact location within pit not specified — check all rooms).

steps.text: Bayle the Dread — legend boss at Jagged Peak Summit. Summon Igon's sign at the fog gate (appears once boss spawns, inside to the left). Summoning Igon is optional for defeating Bayle but required for Igon to drop his bell bearing and set. Bayle does NOT drop a Remembrance — drops Heart of Bayle (key item, see gravesite region). Source: eldenring.wiki.gg/wiki/Bayle_the_Dread + Igon.

steps.note: Jagged Peak area — collected during the ascent. Source: region cleanup (unverified exact location).

steps.text: After defeating Bayle the Dread, return to the site of the Jagged Peak Drake fight. Collect Igon's items from his final location. Note: Bell Bearing and full set only drop if Igon was summoned for the Bayle fight. Source: eldenring.wiki.gg/wiki/Igon.

legs.summary: The Grand Altar of Dragon Communion is in the Jagged Peak foothills. The Dragon Communion Priestess here explains the ritual history. After defeating Bayle the Dread, return to the Altar — she drops the Priestess Heart (MISSABLE: confessing you put her to sleep locks this acquisition path). Then head to Finger Ruins of Dheo (Scaduview, northwest of Fingerstone Hill) for Count Ymir's second bell. Source: eldenring.wiki.gg/wiki/Finger_Ruins_of_Dheo + items.json (Florissax/Priestess Heart acquisition).

steps.text: The Grand Altar of Dragon Communion is near the Foot of the Jagged Peak. After clearing Bayle, return here. The Finger Ruins of Dheo are in Scaduview — head north from Fingerstone Hill (accessible from the Scadu Altus/Scaduview connection).

steps.note: On a corpse in the middle of a big puddle of water, guarded by a rolling lightning ram enemy near Jagged Peak foothills. Source: items.json acquisition text.

steps.text: Ring the hanging bell at the center of Finger Ruins of Dheo. Requires Ruins Map (2nd) from Count Ymir (Cathedral of Manus Metyr) after completing the Rhia bell. Returns the Cerulean Seed Talisman +1 and advances Ymir's quest — return to the cathedral for the final Ruins Map (3rd). Source: eldenring.wiki.gg/wiki/Finger_Ruins_of_Dheo + Count_Ymir.

steps.note: Ring the hanging bell at the center of Finger Ruins of Dheo as part of Count Ymir's quest. Source: items.json acquisition text.
